briefings.title: "Bitcoin Is High Beta — The Crash Isn't Over" | Ram Ahluwalia on Bear Markets, AI Stocks & More
briefings.tldr: The market is undergoing a major rotation away from high-beta "animal spirits" like Bitcoin and tech toward international value and cash-flow-positive assets, while the private AI sector—specifically OpenAI—exhibits characteristics of a speculative bubble and potential "left-tail" risk.
